about: Fixed, local alias map for the Benchmark 0003 alias experiment only. Generic English vocabulary: British/American variants, common synonyms and standard abbreviations. Each group is rewritten to its first member in both questions and texts, keeping a regular inflection (s, es, ed, ing), before tokenisation. It is deliberately not personal: nicknames or relationships (who 'my sister' is) are personal facts, which would need MemoryClaim governance, not a word list. It was written by the author of the queries, so its results are an optimistic upper bound.
